verdict.rationale: Marketing copy states Sprites 'sleep until needed' and that MCP-server Sprites are billed 'only for the tool calls you use,' implying idle time isn't charged, but there's no explicit per-second Machine billing documentation or independent confirmation of active-compute-only pricing for general workloads. Missing for 10: concrete per-second/per-second billing docs for Fly Machines generally, third-party or hands-on verification of idle-time non-billing, and clarity on how this applies beyond the narrow Sprite/MCP use case.
